beats.en: In a tiny room in Moti Vavdi village in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, you see bright cushions, bedcovers and pillows with lovely designs. Ila Sachani, a woman with a big smile, makes them all with a shiny needle.

textbookBox.concept: Ila was born in Amreli, Gujarat, in a farmer's family. She was born with her hands hanging loose by her sides and could not use them in the usual way.

beats.en: Ila was born in Amreli, Gujarat, in a farmer's family. She was born with her hands hanging loose by her sides and could not use them in the usual way. Other children drew figures in the sand or plucked wild flowers.
beats.speakEn: Ila was born in Amreli, Gujarat, in a farmer's family. She was born with her hands hanging loose by her sides and could not use them in the usual way. Other children drew figures in the sand or plucked wild flowers.

beats.en: Threading a needle was hard, but Ila did not give up and became an expert at a young age. Her younger brother and sister helped her.
